mechanism.name: Pointwise conditional mean in the Liang-Liu-Li-Tsai partially linear single-index design

generation_equations.label: 1. Continuous design
generation_equations.expression: For each row i=1..n, independently draw Z_i1,Z_i2,Z_i3 iid Uniform(0,1). Three independent source uniforms; no truncation of the resulting index.

generation_equations.label: 2. Fixed binary design
generation_equations.expression: Set X_i=0 for odd i, X_i=1 for even i (1-based row index). Deterministic source design; no Bernoulli random draw, no added index column, no new noise.

generation_equations.label: 3. Single index
generation_equations.expression: t_i=(Z_i1+Z_i2+Z_i3)/sqrt(3), with 0<=t_i<=sqrt(3). Weights 1/sqrt(3), stored as their finite JSON approximations; 0.5774 is only a four-decimal display.

generation_equations.label: 4. Mean function
generation_equations.expression: m_i=sin(pi*(t_i-0.3912)/(1.3409-0.3912))+0.3*X_i. Deterministic; a,b are phase/scale constants, not truncation limits. Sine can be negative outside [a,b].

generation_equations.label: 5. Innovation
generation_equations.expression: epsilon_i iid N(0,1), independent of all design uniforms. Source multiplier 0.1 gives noise sd=0.1 and variance=0.01; it is applied once.

generation_equations.label: 6. Response and export
generation_equations.expression: Y_i=m_i+0.1*epsilon_i; export Z1,Z2,Z3,X,Y in row order. No index t, noiseless mean or noise column is returned.

sampling.unit: one independent observed row (Z1,Z2,Z3,X,Y), preserving 1-based row order
sampling.dependence: Independent rows with deterministic alternating X: odd rows 0, even rows 1. They are not identically distributed. Z draws and errors are independent across rows; there is no cluster/Markov dependence.

assumptions: For each row, Z1,Z2,Z3 are independent Uniform(0,1); uniforms and zero-mean Gaussian errors are independent across rows.
X is fixed by the 1-based row index: odd rows 0, even rows 1. Rows are independent but not identically distributed; no stochastic Bernoulli design or causal treatment assignment is introduced.
With fixed design X, the common regression function is m(z,x)=sin(pi*((z1+z2+z3)/sqrt(3)-a)/(b-a))+beta*x. Independent centred errors identify this function in both X groups.
The source formula uses the full index support [0,sqrt(3)]; a=.3912 and b=1.3409 are phase/scale constants, not clipping, truncation or domain limits.

Complete queries fix Z1,Z2,Z3 and X in config. All queries have valid Z in [0,1]^3 and binary X. The n>=2 interface check has both fixed X levels; this is pointwise mean verification, not a confidence-band result.

properties.notes: Four observed input covariates Z1,Z2,Z3,X all affect the full conditional mean; dimension=effective_dimension=4 as the student guide defines active covariates. The continuous nonparametric component has one structural index, a separate notion from the number of active covariates. With k=pi/(b-a), mixed derivatives across distinct Z coordinates are -k^2*w_j*w_l*sin(k*(t-a)), generally nonzero, so the mean has nonadditive Z-Z interactions. X enters only as beta*X, with no X-Z interaction. d=4 is small relative to source n50/100/200. The index t is not an exported column.

estimand.name: eta(z0'alpha) + x0*beta = E[Y | Z = z0, X = x0]
estimand.definition: The scalar conditional mean at the scenario's fixed covariate query (z0, x0). The nonparametric component is evaluated at the single-index value t0 = z0'alpha with alpha = (1,1,1)/sqrt(3); the linear component contributes x0*beta. This is a pointwise target, not a curve-level or band target.

truth.expression: The scalar conditional mean at the scenario's fixed covariate query (z0, x0). The nonparametric component is evaluated at the single-index value t0 = z0'alpha with alpha = (1,1,1)/sqrt(3); the linear component contributes x0*beta. truth.derivation: Closed-form evaluation of sin((t0-a)*pi/(b-a)) with t0 = z0'alpha plus x0*beta at the fixed query.

adaptations: Retain model (4.2), independent U(0,1) Z coordinates, source 1-based fixed odd/even X=0/1, exact index formula (Z1+Z2+Z3)/sqrt(3), beta=.3, a=.3912, b=1.3409 and error sd=.1. Weights are stored as finite JSON approximations to 1/sqrt(3); .5774 in the source is its four-decimal display.
Select four fixed complete queries (Z1,Z2,Z3,X) and target their scalar conditional response means. These queries are contribution choices, not source experiment parameters.

Use the requested interface row count rather than only source n=50/100/200. Preserve alternating X in numeric list order; a separate index column is unnecessary. Source 500 estimator repetitions, profile least squares, SCAD and tests are not executed.
